name: Halloween
description: Settle in with a Halloween word search made for grown-up puzzlers. These free online puzzles gather the classic vocabulary of late October: lanterns, harvest moons, costumes, cobwebs and candlelit porches. Every grid is hand-themed and playable right in your browser with no download or sign-up. Choose an easy puzzle for a gentle warm-up, a medium grid with diagonal words, or a hard puzzle where words can run backwards. There is no timer and no pressure, just a seasonal word list and a quiet few minutes. New Halloween puzzles are added through the season, so check back as the nights draw in.
